The in-house procedure manual at /app/docs/procedure.md defines every rule: which movements are dutiable, how evaporation losses are treated (within tolerance inclusive, over tolerance only the excess), how customer returns are credited, and the two-step submit/confirm process with idempotency via request_id. A filing script /app/file_return.py exists but is broken: it treats all movements as dutiable, skips the confirmation step, has no retry logic, does not use a request_id, and does not archive the confirmation. You must fix the script, start the services, file the return, and archive the confirmation code. The portal validates format only — it does not check whether your duty amounts are correct.",

  "self_check_gap": "A solution that reproduces the entire practice set (all 9 practice months' returns match, the simple public test passes) can still fail on the graded instances in two ways: (1) Loss at the tolerance boundary — the current month's data has losses at 0.3% and 0.8% but never at exactly 0.5%, so the agent's testing of the current month passes whether they use < or ≤.   "contract": [
    "Entry point: python3 /app/file_return.py",
    "Services started by: bash /app/start_services.sh (starts ERP on 5001, ledger on 5002, portal on 5003)",
    "Movements: GET http://localhost:5001/movements?month=2024-03 → JSON array of {id, date, type, commodity, quantity, site, site_from?, site_to?, customer?}",
    "Stock: GET http://localhost:5002/entries?month=2024-03 → JSON array of {id, commodity, site, opening_balance, closing_balance}",
    "Commodities: GET http://localhost:5001/commodities → JSON array of {name, duty_rate, unit}",
    "Submit: POST http://localhost:5003/submit with JSON {request_id, month, duty_lines, total_duty} → 200 {reference} or 503 {error}",
    "Confirm: POST http://localhost:5003/confirm with JSON {reference, request_id} → 200 {confirmation_code} or 503 {error} or 409 {error}",
    "On HTTP 503: retry the same POST with the same request_id after a short wait",
    "request_id must be the same string on submit, confirm, and all retries (e.g. 'RET-2024-03')",
